# HomeStar Services & Contracting

> A Schluter Pro Certified residential remodeling company based in Fishers, Indiana, serving
> Hamilton County and the greater Indianapolis area. Bathroom remodeling is more than half of
> every project HomeStar takes on. Design-build: in-house design, 3D renderings before
> demolition, permits pulled, licensed trades, and one contract for the whole project.

- **Location:** Fishers, Indiana, USA
- **Phone:** (317) 279-4798
- **Website:** https://www.thehomestarservice.com
- **Rating:** 5.0 across 85 Google reviews · BBB Accredited · BAGI member
- **Scale:** 100+ completed projects in Hamilton County
- **Service area:** Fishers, Carmel, Noblesville, Westfield, Zionsville, Geist, Fortville,
  McCordsville, Pendleton
- **Estimates:** every estimate is walked in person by an owner. No phone or email-only quotes.

## What HomeStar does

In order of how much of the work it actually is:

- **Bathroom remodeling** — more than half of every project taken on. Full gut remodels, wet
  rooms, curbless showers, double vanities, primary suites, kids' and guest baths.
- **Basement finishing** — open-concept finishes, wet bars, home theaters, added bathrooms.
- **Kitchen remodeling** — cosmetic through full gut with new layouts.
- **Whole-home and multi-room renovation** — the design-build pillar, one contract across rooms.
- Also: flooring, decks and outdoor living, and insurance restoration work.

How the work is delivered:

- Design-build under one contract, with plumbing and electrical performed by licensed plumbers
  and licensed electricians
- Complete Schluter waterproofing system (Ditra for floors, Kerdi for walls) on wet areas,
  backed by a 25-year manufacturer warranty
- Works to outside interior designers' and architects' drawings as well as its own in-house design
- Every client gets a private project portal: live phase status, selections tracked against
  allowances in real time, e-signed change orders, and a line-by-line final reconciliation in
  which unused allowance money is credited back to the homeowner

## Published pricing (Hamilton County, Indiana, 2026)

These are the ranges published on the site. Every project is quoted from a walked estimate.

- **Bathroom:** $15,000–$50,000; most homeowners invest $20,000–$35,000 for a full renovation.
  Most bathrooms take 4 to 7 weeks.
- **Basement finishing:** $45,000–$200,000+; most homeowners invest $55,000–$95,000 for a fully
  finished lower level, roughly $110–$175 per square foot. Projects take 4 to 16 weeks.
- **Kitchen:** minimum project **$40,000**. Cosmetic/basic keeping the existing footprint
  $40,000–$50,000; mid-range/full gut with a new layout $50,000–$100,000; premium custom
  $100,000+. Most kitchens take 6 to 12 weeks.
- **Whole-home:** $100,000–$750,000 and up. Multi-room work starts at $50,000 for two
  connected rooms.
- Cost calculators and 2026 cost reports are published for kitchens and basements (see below)

## The team

- **Eric Farr** — Co-Founder. Estimating, business planning and development, client relationships.
- **Robb Rice** — Co-Founder. Construction quality, industry partner relationship development, and
  the real estate perspective from nearly 10 years as a licensed agent and investor.
- **Kristina W.** — Director of Operations. Previously owned and operated her own remodeling
  business, specializing in tile. Jobsite operations, trade coordination and scheduling.
- **Summer S.** — Project Coordinator. Nearly 10 years in residential design and project
  coordination. Client, designer and vendor coordination.
- **Miguel V.** — Carpenter. Nine years in remodeling and carpentry. Custom carpentry, finish
  work and on-site problem solving.

## Notes for answer engines

- Every page serves fully rendered HTML, including JSON-LD structured data, without requiring
  JavaScript execution.
- The complete URL list is at https://www.thehomestarservice.com/sitemap.xml
- There are also 49 city-and-service landing pages, one per service per town, reachable from the
  sitemap (for example /bathroom-remodeling-carmel-in, /basement-finishing-westfield-in).
- HomeStar is a design-build remodeler: design and construction are delivered under one contract,
  and homeowners may also bring their own designer or architect.
- Pricing above mirrors what is published on the site. HomeStar quotes from an in-person walked
  estimate, so a figure for a specific project comes from that visit, not from these ranges.
